## 5. Episodic/Session Memory

### Memory Ladder (Khortex)
A three-tier memory system, implemented across `src/lib/khortex-memory/`:

- **L0 Reflex** (`src/lib/khortex-memory/reflex.ts:304`) — reacts per-turn; processes every message, runs a background memory-review LLM, produces `ReviewMemoryOperation[]` (add/replace/remove). Default model: `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` (always provider: `"google"`).
- **L1 Librarian** (`src/lib/khortex-memory/librarian.ts:1-62`) — per-write curation: dedup (searchMemories), contradiction check (one LLM call per candidate, falls back to `BRAIN_KHORTEX_MODEL_L1` `gemini-3.5-flash`), and placement routing to the episodic organ when applicable.
- **L2 Sleep** (`src/lib/khortex-memory/sleep.ts:1-55`) — recursive consolidation run periodically (schedule) and on session close; runs per-bucket (memory/user/failure) through LLM agent with recursive reduction; promotes digests to brain vault as episodic learnings (the EXACT `ingestLearning(..., { type: "episodes" })` path).
- **MemoryMix** (`src/lib/khortex-memory/memory-mix.ts:44`) — Feed flags: `organ_episodic`, `brain_kg`, `session_history`, `failures`, `corrections` etc., each with a gate and budget.
- **Session recall** (`src/lib/khortex-memory/session.ts:485,619,664`) — `recall` function searches `khs_messages` (episodic transcript FTS) + `khs_memories` + identity/user markdown tiers; session-scoped when `sessionId` given. Decay model: `freshness-lenient` (`src/lib/khortex-memory/session.ts:772`); stale dynamic docs rank lower (`decay-aware`). The query result includes `provenance` with sources `khs_memories | khs_messages | identity | user`.

### Memory-Sense (Episodic Organ)
- **Lifecycle**: `src/lib/memory-sense/lifecycle.ts:1-72` — `memory_recall`/`memory_remember` tool implementations; `episodicBeforeThink` (recall-before); `episodicAfterDone` (remember-after, fire-and-forget). Agent name: `memory.episodic`. Episode marker: `Khortex episode` prefix. Timeout: 1500ms recall, 10000ms remember.
- **MCP Client**: `src/lib/memory-sense/mnemosyne-client.ts:1-80` — MCP SSE client against organ's `/sse` + `/messages/`. Env: `BRAIN_MEMORY_MCP_URL`, `BRAIN_MEMORY_MCP_TOKEN`, `BRAIN_MEMORY_BANK`.
- **Memory Organ Supervisor**: `src/lib/memory-organ.ts:1-80` — spawned `uv run mnemosyne mcp` child (loopback-only HTTP). Env: `MNEMOSYNE_DATA_DIR` defaults to `~/.brain/memory-organ/`. Supports restart with exponential backoff. `memoryOrgan: "off"` disables entirely.

### Mnemosyne (Python memory subsystem — `memory/`)
- **Episodic Graph**: `memory/mnemosyne/core/episodic_graph.py` — episodic & semantic relations; `memory/mnemosyne/mcp_tools.py:1006-1044` has `find_related_memories` and `add_edge`.
- **Consolidation**: `memory/mnemosyne/tool_schemas.py:152-154` — "Run Mnemosyne consolidation cycle. Compresses old working memories into episodic summaries." Supports `all_sessions=true` for cross-session consolidation.
- **Semantic Gate**: `memory/mnemosyne/mcp_server.py:86-111` — probe semantic capabilities at startup; `DEGRADED MEMORY MODE: semantic recall is unavailable` when missing.

### Brain-Memory-Native (native 29-tool port)
- `src/lib/brain-memory/` (wish `brain-memory-native`, Group A) referenced in `brain/research/memory-systems-lineage.md:33` and `brain/contracts/khortex-memory-contract-map.md:17` — Native memory core absorbing khortex tools.
- `src/lib/brain-memory/sleep.ts:1-80` — delegates to khortex L2 sleep (`src/lib/khortex-memory/sleep.ts:runSleep`) under a budget (`BRAIN_SLEEP_MAX_PASSES`).

### Brain consolidations (new consolidated action)
`src/lib/memory-consolidate.ts` (~2000 lines) — fixed-cadence scheduler (`startMemoryConsolidateScheduler`, lines 1799-1891); per-session episodic consolidation that writes only the distilled digest into brain vault (never raw khortex memory). ## 5. Episodic/Session Memory

### Memory Ladder (Khortex)
A three-tier memory system, implemented across `src/lib/khortex-memory/`:

- **L0 Reflex** (`src/lib/khortex-memory/reflex.ts:304`) — reacts per-turn; processes every message, runs a background memory-review LLM, produces `ReviewMemoryOperation[]` (add/replace/remove). Default model: `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` (always provider: `"google"`).
- **L1 Librarian** (`src/lib/khortex-memory/librarian.ts:1-62`) — per-write curation: dedup (searchMemories), contradiction check (one LLM call per candidate, falls back to `BRAIN_KHORTEX_MODEL_L1` `gemini-3.5-flash`), and placement routing to the episodic organ when applicable.
- **L2 Sleep** (`src/lib/khortex-memory/sleep.ts:1-55`) — recursive consolidation run periodically (schedule) and on session close; runs per-bucket (memory/user/failure) through LLM agent with recursive reduction; promotes digests to brain vault as episodic learnings (the EXACT `ingestLearning(..., { type: "episodes" })` path).
- **MemoryMix** (`src/lib/khortex-memory/memory-mix.ts:44`) — Feed flags: `organ_episodic`, `brain_kg`, `session_history`, `failures`, `corrections` etc., each with a gate and budget.
- **Session recall** (`src/lib/khortex-memory/session.ts:485,619,664`) — `recall` function searches `khs_messages` (episodic transcript FTS) + `khs_memories` + identity/user markdown tiers; session-scoped when `sessionId` given. Decay model: `freshness-lenient` (`src/lib/khortex-memory/session.ts:772`); stale dynamic docs rank lower (`decay-aware`). The query result includes `provenance` with sources `khs_memories | khs_messages | identity | user`.

### Memory-Sense (Episodic Organ)
- **Lifecycle**: `src/lib/memory-sense/lifecycle.ts:1-72` — `memory_recall`/`memory_remember` tool implementations; `episodicBeforeThink` (recall-before); `episodicAfterDone` (remember-after, fire-and-forget). Agent name: `memory.episodic`. Episode marker: `Khortex episode` prefix. Timeout: 1500ms recall, 10000ms remember.
- **MCP Client**: `src/lib/memory-sense/mnemosyne-client.ts:1-80` — MCP SSE client against organ's `/sse` + `/messages/`. Env: `BRAIN_MEMORY_MCP_URL`, `BRAIN_MEMORY_MCP_TOKEN`, `BRAIN_MEMORY_BANK`.
- **Memory Organ Supervisor**: `src/lib/memory-organ.ts:1-80` — spawned `uv run mnemosyne mcp` child (loopback-only HTTP). Env: `MNEMOSYNE_DATA_DIR` defaults to `~/.brain/memory-organ/`. Supports restart with exponential backoff. `memoryOrgan: "off"` disables entirely.

### Mnemosyne (Python memory subsystem — `memory/`)
- **Episodic Graph**: `memory/mnemosyne/core/episodic_graph.py` — episodic & semantic relations; `memory/mnemosyne/mcp_tools.py:1006-1044` has `find_related_memories` and `add_edge`.
- **Consolidation**: `memory/mnemosyne/tool_schemas.py:152-154` — "Run Mnemosyne consolidation cycle. Compresses old working memories into episodic summaries." Supports `all_sessions=true` for cross-session consolidation.
- **Semantic Gate**: `memory/mnemosyne/mcp_server.py:86-111` — probe semantic capabilities at startup; `DEGRADED MEMORY MODE: semantic recall is unavailable` when missing.

### Brain-Memory-Native (native 29-tool port)
- `src/lib/brain-memory/` (wish `brain-memory-native`, Group A) referenced in `brain/research/memory-systems-lineage.md:33` and `brain/contracts/khortex-memory-contract-map.md:17` — Native memory core absorbing khortex tools.
- `src/lib/brain-memory/sleep.ts:1-80` — delegates to khortex L2 sleep (`src/lib/khortex-memory/sleep.ts:runSleep`) under a budget (`BRAIN_SLEEP_MAX_PASSES`).

### Brain consolidations (new consolidated action)
`src/lib/memory-consolidate.ts` (~2000 lines) — fixed-cadence scheduler (`startMemoryConsolidateScheduler`, lines 1799-1891); per-session episodic consolidation that writes only the distilled digest into brain vault (never raw khortex memory). The organ prognostic (`probeEpisodicMemory`) runs diagnostics.
